edits.old: Following method describes the way in which this startup's engineers save the data in the structure.
edits.new: The engineers now reverse each word before inserting it into a trie. Consequently the structure shares suffixes of the original words, rather than prefixes. Count every trie node, including the empty root.

region_edits.before:
Suppose they have 5 strings/words: et,eq,bd,be,bdp
A empty node is kept NULL, and strings are inserted into the structure one by one. 
Initially the structure is this:

NULL

After inserting "et", the structure is this:

NULL
 |
 e
 |
 t

After inserting "eq", the structure is this:

   NULL
   /
  e
 / \
t   q

After inserting "bd", the structure is this:

   NULL
   /  \
  e    b
 / \    \
t   q    d

After inserting "be", the structure is this:

     NULL
   /     \
  e       b
 / \     / \
t   q   e   d

After inserting "bdp", the structure is this:

    NULL
   /     \
  e       b
 / \     / \
t   q   e   d
             \
              p

Therefore a total of 8 nodes are used here.
region_edits.after: For example, for the five words et, eq, bd, be, bdp, insert te, qe, db, eb, pdb into the trie. The root has children t, q, d, e and p. Their respective branches contain 2, 2, 2, 2 and 3 nodes excluding the root, so the total required number of nodes is 12.
